bio.text: Christian D. Menefee represents Texas's 18th Congressional District, which includes downtown Houston and adjacent communities.
Before Congress he was Harris County Attorney, and earlier practiced commercial litigation.
He grew up in Houston's public schools, is the son of two U.S. Coast Guard veterans, and lives in Houston with his wife and sons.
